svg.title: Java Memory Model and volatile Visibility Barrier
svg.desc: Animated hardware diagram illustrating Core 1 writing a volatile variable into its Store Buffer, a StoreLoad memory barrier flushing the write through L1/L2 cache to Main Memory RAM, a MESI cache-line invalidation signal clearing Core 2 stale L1/L2 cache, and Core 2 reloading the fresh value.
svg.text: Java Memory Model & volatile Visibility Barrier
StoreLoad Memory Barrier • Store Buffer Flush to RAM • MESI Cache-Line Invalidation & Reload
and flushes updated line to RAM
